title: Fix an applied migration that was edited
prompt: Production ran `inferlo db migrate --apply` and got warning IL4018: migrations/0001_init.sql was edited after it was applied. Someone added the `pinned` field to notes by editing that file instead of writing a new migration, so the production database has no pinned column. Keep the `pinned` field in the model. Restore migrations/0001_init.sql to the SQL that was applied, and add migrations/0002_add_pinned.sql with exactly the SQL `inferlo db migrate add_pinned` would generate for the pinned field, keeping migrations/snapshot.json matching the models. You cannot run commands.
